title: Automated Robotic Arm — Pick and Place
description: Designed and fabricated a custom 6-DOF pick-and-place arm — DH-parameter-optimized PyBullet inverse kinematics, real-time Python control with a custom Unity GUI, cycloidal actuators, and 3D-printed structural components. Built with a 4-person team.

title: Shenz — EdTech Blog and Registration Backend
description: Django REST Framework API for an EdTech platform — blog CRUD with category search and pagination, instructor registration, and a homepage slider.

title: CampusHub — EdTech Platform with Courses and Community
description: Django platform with a course catalogue, community forum, and a nested-comment rating system on PostgreSQL.
